notes.description: Check the owner's request, accepted amendments and claimed result separately. Quote each narrowed requirement and also raise it as a Request: issue; for unclear say why and what would settle it.

checks.description: Every verification bearing on the verdict (tests, builds, linters, type checks, scripts, reproductions), not file reads or searches. The runner compares these with saved command events. Run each check so its own exit is the command's exit: no | tail, || true, or ; echo. Piped or masked checks remain unconfirmed; redirects are allowed.

command.description: The exact shell command as run, or the intended command when skipped.

note.description: Short reason for a failure or skipped check; empty when no explanation is needed.

gaps.description: Parts of the subject or task not examined, or only partly examined; [] when none.

verdict.description: approve = nothing left you would block on; revise = changes are still needed.

summary.description: 1-3 sentences: a terse ship / no-ship assessment of the subject in its current state.

issues.description: Round 1: all issues found. Later rounds: every issue the author answered, plus new or reopened ones.

id.description: Permanent id: C1, C2, ... Reuse ids from earlier rounds; new issues take the next free number.

status.description: open = still needs work; resolved = verified fixed; withdrawn = dropped after the author's argument or the owner's decision.

body.description: What goes wrong, why (evidence), and the impact.

location.description: path:start-end, plan step or document section; empty if not applicable.

confidence.description: 0..1, how sure you are that the issue is real.

reply.description: Your answer to the author's latest response on this issue; empty in round 1 and for new issues.
